pages.title: The Folding Library
pages.summary: A paper crane folds itself through a library that rewrites its own shelves at night.
pages.body:
## Pitch
A single sheet of paper wakes up folded into a crane. The library around it is vast, silent and alive: every night the shelves unwrite and rewrite themselves, so no route stays true. The crane must climb from the lamplit [[reading_room]] to the [[lantern_roof]], learning new folds as it goes, to find out who is editing the building.

## Tone
Quiet, tactile, melancholy but warm. Dust in lamplight, the rustle of pages, ink pooling in margins. Danger is gentle in look and sharp in play.

## Themes
- Memory and revision: what is lost when a story is rewritten.
- Fragility as strength: paper that can be folded can be reshaped.
- Authorship: who decides what a place, or a self, is meant to say.

## World structure
- [[reading_room]]: the safe start.
- [[shifting_stacks]]: the great rewriting shelves.
- [[bindery]]: where folds are taught and the library is mended.
- [[lantern_roof]]: the final ascent.

## Cast
[[wanderer]] is the crane; [[crawler]] and [[charger]] are the library's defensive ink-creatures.

## Core loop
Explore by day, when shelves hold still. Each new fold (a movement ability) reaches shelves that were out of reach and reveals what the night changed.

pages.title: Wanderer
pages.summary: A paper crane that folded itself awake and must climb the library to learn who rewrites it.
pages.body:
The Wanderer is a crane of cream-coloured paper, creased by its own wings. It has no voice; it speaks through the way it folds and unfolds.

It begins in the [[reading_room]] with only a short hop and a flutter. Each fold it learns in the [[bindery]] and beyond changes its silhouette and its reach.

Its secret: the paper it is made from is a page torn from the library's first, original book, which is why the night rewriting cannot touch it.

fields.appearance: small origami crane, soft creases, faint ink lines showing through the paper
fields.motivation: to find the hand that rewrites the shelves and learn what page it came from

pages.title: Crawler
pages.summary: A slow ink-beetle that patrols shelves and floors, leaving sticky blots.
pages.body:
Crawlers are blots of ink that learned to walk, shaped like low beetles. They trudge along shelves, floors and ledges on set routes, as if still copying a line of text.

They are most common in the [[shifting_stacks]] and the [[reading_room]]. They are slow and predictable; their threat is blocking narrow ledges and the damage of touching them.

When defeated they splash into a harmless stain that fades by morning, and by night they re-form.

fields.behavior: patrols a platform back and forth, turns at edges
fields.appearance: glossy black beetle of ink with pale text-line legs

pages.title: Charger
pages.summary: A bound-book beast that lunges at the crane when it spots it.
pages.body:
Chargers are heavy bestiary tomes with pages for jaws and a spine that ripples like muscle. They sleep shut on the floor until the Wanderer comes into line of sight, then burst open and rush forward in a straight line.

They guard corridors in the [[shifting_stacks]] and the approaches to the [[bindery]]. Sidestepping or leaping over the rush leaves them stunned against the wall.

They are the library's attempt to protect itself; they do not know who they are protecting it from.

fields.behavior: waits, then charges in a straight line when the player is in sight, stunned after hitting a wall
fields.appearance: leather-bound tome with page-teeth and a ribbon bookmark tail

pages.title: The Reading Room
pages.summary: A lamplit hall of desks and armchairs where the crane wakes; the safe start.
pages.body:
The first room the [[wanderer]] knows. Green-shaded lamps, long oak tables, open books left mid-sentence. It is the only part of the library that never rewrites, kept still by a stubborn old reading lamp.

Here the player learns the basics: hopping across desks, reading ledges, dodging a few [[crawler|Crawlers]]. A sealed stair leads down to the [[shifting_stacks]].

fields.appearance: oak tables, green lamps, drifting dust motes

pages.title: The Shifting Stacks
pages.summary: Towering shelves that unwrite and rebuild themselves each night.
pages.body:
Canyons of bookshelves climbing out of sight. Each night the shelves slide, swap and regrow, so ledges, gaps and shortcuts change between visits. Landmarks stay: a fallen globe, a ladder that always leans somewhere new.

Home to [[crawler|Crawlers]] and [[charger|Chargers]]. Paths onward lead to the [[bindery]] and, high above, the [[lantern_roof]].

fields.appearance: endless shelves, sliding ladders, loose pages falling like snow

pages.title: The Bindery
pages.summary: A workshop of presses, thread and glue where new folds are learned.
pages.body:
A warm, cluttered workshop beneath the stacks: book presses, spools of waxed thread, bone folders, drying racks of unbound pages. Here the library is mended, and here the [[wanderer]] is taught the folds that become its abilities.

[[charger|Chargers]] guard its approaches. Its presses still run at night, which hints that someone is rewriting the library from here. The way up to the [[lantern_roof]] begins above its tallest press.

fields.appearance: presses, thread spools, drying racks, glue-pot glow
fields.role: ability area and story turning point

pages.title: The Lantern Roof
pages.summary: The glass-and-paper rooftop where the night editor works under hanging lanterns.
pages.body:
Above the stacks, the library opens to the sky under a ceiling of paper lanterns and cracked glass. Wind carries loose pages like flocks of birds, a place made for a crane.

The rewriting begins here. The final climb from the [[shifting_stacks]] and the [[bindery]] ends at the first book's empty cover, where the [[wanderer]] learns what page it came from.

fields.appearance: paper lanterns, cracked glass dome, night sky

pages.title: The Inkwell Cellar
pages.summary: A flooded undercroft of ink wells beneath the stacks, where the library's ink is brewed and wall-clinging folds are learned.
pages.body:
Beneath the [[shifting_stacks]] lie the wells that feed the library's ink. Black pools, dripping stone walls and tall narrow shafts make the cellar a place of climbing.

Its guardian is an oversized [[crawler]], the Well Warden, who lets no page leave with the fold of the grip. A shortcut leads back up to the [[reading_room]].

fields.appearance: ink wells, dripping vaulted stone, narrow vertical shafts
fields.role: optional-feeling detour that unlocks wall_jump and a shortcut

pages.title: The First Fold
pages.summary: The crane wakes in the Reading Room and climbs into the Stacks, where a hulking tome guards the first new fold.
pages.body: The [[wanderer]] wakes in the [[reading_room]] and finds the shelves beyond rearranged. In the [[shifting_stacks]] it defeats the Tome Warden and learns the Mountain Fold, a second leap in mid-air.

pages.title: What the Ink Remembers
pages.summary: In the Inkwell Cellar the crane learns to cling to walls and finds the way into the Bindery.
pages.body: Below the stacks, the [[wanderer]] meets the Well Warden in the [[inkwell_cellar]] and learns the Crease Grip. The ink shows fragments of the first book it was torn from.

pages.title: The Night Editor
pages.summary: With the Lantern Key from the Bindery, the crane ascends to the roof to face whoever rewrites the library.
pages.body: In the [[bindery]] the [[wanderer]] learns the Swift Fold and defeats the Master Binder for the Lantern Key. It opens the way to the [[lantern_roof]], where the editor's identity is revealed.

direction.style: Hand-drawn 2D game art. Bold, readable silhouettes built from simple shapes; thick dark ink outlines; flat muted, desaturated colors with a single bright accent (glowing eyes, a lantern); pale masks against dark bodies. Melancholy, gloomy underground insect-kingdom mood. Minimal interior detail; charm comes from shape and proportion.

rooms.name: Reading Room Entrance
rooms.notes: Quiet start hall: long reading tables, dusty lamps, folded-paper moths. Safe teaching space for walking and jumping.

rooms.name: Lectern Aisle
rooms.notes: Rows of lecterns form low platforms; first crawlers patrol between them.

rooms.name: Reading Lamp Alcove
rooms.notes: Small raised alcove with a green-shaded lamp and a save point. A breather before the stacks.

rooms.name: Catalogue Gallery
rooms.notes: Wide gallery of card catalogues leading to the shelves beyond. Crawlers guard the exit.

rooms.name: Stacks Threshold
rooms.notes: Towering shelves begin; ledges of book spines rise upward.

rooms.name: Spine Ladder
rooms.notes: A tall shaft of shelves; climbing book-spine ledges with crawlers on the ledges.

rooms.name: Drifting Shelves
rooms.notes: Shelves slide as if rearranging themselves; wide room with uneven platforms.

rooms.name: Librarian's Landing
rooms.notes: A quiet landing between shelves with a save point, junction to the gated routes.

rooms.name: Fallen Index
rooms.notes: Collapsed shelves and scattered pages; spikes of broken shelving.

rooms.name: Creased Wall Hall
rooms.notes: Tall papered walls, deeply creased; the way to the Bindery needs Crease Grip.

rooms.name: Charger's Pen
rooms.notes: Open arena of cleared floor where the Charger guards the Mountain Fold (double jump).

rooms.name: Cellar Stairs
rooms.notes: Dripping stairwell down into the ink-stained cellar. Dark, damp, a first charger.

rooms.name: Ink Vats
rooms.notes: Rows of huge ink vats; black pools form hazards between walkways.

rooms.name: Cooper's Nook
rooms.notes: Barrel-lined nook with a save point, lit by a single candle.

rooms.name: Blotted Tunnel
rooms.notes: Long low tunnel with ink seeping from the walls; chargers make it tense.

rooms.name: The Well of Ink
rooms.notes: Arena around a great ink well. The Crawler guardian holds Crease Grip (wall jump). A dash shortcut leads back to the Reading Room.

rooms.name: Press Hall Entrance
rooms.notes: Walled approach lined with presses and glue pots.

rooms.name: Stitching Floor
rooms.notes: Wide workshop of sewing frames and thread, crawlers among the looms.

rooms.name: Glue Pits
rooms.notes: Pits of sticky glue and spiked press plates to cross.

rooms.name: Shrine of the Swift Fold
rooms.notes: A small shrine of folded paper cranes holding the dash, with a save point. A dash-gated passage leads to the key chamber.

rooms.name: Guillotine Gallery
rooms.notes: Vertical gallery of paper-cutter blades above; climbing with care.

rooms.name: Gilded Stair
rooms.notes: Gilt-edged stair to the sealed door of the Lantern Roof, locked without the key and dash.

rooms.name: Skylight Stair
rooms.notes: Climb out through a broken skylight into moonlit night wind.

rooms.name: Slate Ridge
rooms.notes: Long windy roof ridge of slate tiles with gaps.

rooms.name: Gargoyle Perch
rooms.notes: Sheltered perch under a gargoyle with a save point before the finale.

rooms.name: Chimney Climb
rooms.notes: Chimney stacks and ledges; needs all four abilities.

rooms.name: The Lantern
rooms.notes: The great lantern at the roof's peak where the Night Editor waits; the ending.

rooms.name: Key Cache
rooms.notes: Hidden chamber across a dash gap; the Charger guardian keeps the Lantern Key.
